summary: San Francisco Bay Area, UNIX SysAdmin, self-taught, VPS hosting entrepreneur, experience in hiring underemployed technical talent, strong belief in meritocracy and technical competence over formal education, advocates for open-source software, critical of marketing practices, values transparency and honesty in business, prefers command-line interfaces over GUIs, emphasizes the importance of experience and practical skills over credentials, supports flexible work arrangements, has a history of working in tech during the .com boom, operates a small hosting company (prgmr.com), interested in automation and efficiency in server management, skeptical of venture capital and traditional business models, values community and peer relationships in tech, has a personal interest in improving technical literacy and access to technology.
